form.p: Totals posted BNPL receipts dated before the accounting start (default 1 Jan 2026) and posts one opening-balance journal entry per stand on that date (JE1 for the contract plus a lumped receipt). Then deletes those pre-start receipts and leftover stand-sales JEs. The customer portal keeps the full payment history; only Odoo books are cut over. Take an Odoo.sh backup first.

button.name: action_apply
button.string: Post opening balances and delete pre-start receipts
button.confirm: This deletes all stand-sales receipts dated before the accounting start and replaces them with one opening-balance JE per stand. The customer portal is not changed. Continue?

button.name: action_force_delete_pre_start_jes
button.confirm: This unreconciles and deletes leftover stand-sales journal entries dated before the accounting start. Opening balances already posted are kept. Continue?
